items.title: What Sauna Research Actually Shows About Longevity
items.summary: Sauna is one of the longevity practices I use consistently, but the evidence needs to be described honestly. The widely shared reductions in mortality, cardiovascular events, and dementia come largely from observational Finnish data, not randomized trials proving sauna caused those outcomes. The research is still compelling enough to take seriously, especially around cardiovascular conditioning and heat adaptation, but it is not a guarantee. I also track my own toxic-burden results and have seen lower levels during periods when I use sauna. That is useful personal data, not proof that sauna “detoxes” everyone. My approach is to separate established evidence, promising associations, and personal response. Hydration, heat tolerance, medical conditions, and recovery still matter more than chasing the hottest temperature or longest session. #Sauna #Longevity #HeatTherapy #CardiovascularHealth #HealthyAging

items.title: Why Do You Feel Hungry at Certain Times? | Hunger Signals Explained | Genomaxis #glp1
items.summary: Why do you feel hungry at certain times of the day? Your hunger isn't random—it is influenced by hormones, energy needs, and signals between your body and brain. In this video, we explain how hunger signals, ghrelin, and leptin help regulate hunger and fullness, and why everyone can experience hunger at different times. You'll learn: Why hunger signals change throughout the day What ghrelin does and why it is linked to hunger How leptin is involved in fullness signaling Why everyone's hunger rhythm can be different How appetite regulation relates to modern metabolic health research Understanding these signals can provide a better perspective on appetite regulation, hunger hormones, and weight management. Learn more about the science behind GLP-1 peptides and appetite regulation through Genomaxis.

items.title: Launch HN: RonanRX (YC S26) – Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
items.summary: Hi HN, I’m Lloyd, one of two founders of RonanRx ( https://ronanrx.com/ ). We are building a vertically integrated pharmaceutical company with software for prescribing, telehealth, compounding, manufacturing, and delivery. We are starting with GLP-1s and peptides. The path to RonanRx is fairly unconventional. During the pandemic, I built one of the largest mask manufacturing factories in the US. We could make a million masks in a day. We converted raw polypropylene pellets into finished pallets of masks. I had a background in software from my YC W10 company, so we took a software approach to building our factory. We used machine learning and computer vision to optimize production. We also vertically integrated almost everything. It worked. We built an efficient manufacturing operation and grew the business to 50 million dollars in revenue. Then people actually stopped caring about masks. Fair enough. Around the same time, I decided to try and lose the weight I had gained while building the factory. I ate nothing but chicken for six months. While this diet got some results, I plateaued. My doctor suggested tirzepatide, a GLP-1 medication. For me, losing weight was only the beginning. "Food noise" was gone. I showed less interest in other compulsive behavior. I stopped scrolling Instagram and quit biting my nails. But that was just the beginning. I was born with a congenital heart defect called aortic stenosis. My whole life doctors told me I'd need open heart surgery in my…

items.title: What Birth Control Actually Does To Your Bone Density
items.summary: Birth control is one of the most common questions in women's health, and the decision is never one-size-fits-all. Hormonal birth control suppresses natural estrogen and progesterone production, which over time can affect bone density, something rarely explained at the point of prescription. This isn't about telling anyone to stop taking it. It's about making the decision an informed one, including lower-hormone options and how to support bone health if staying on it. #WomensHealth #FemaleLongevity #BirthControl #HormoneHealth #BoneHealth #WomensWellness #LongevityTips

items.title: Biomarker Series: The Number That Drops 10% A Year After 30
items.summary: VO2 max is one of the strongest predictors of long-term health available right now, and it's measurable at multiple levels of precision. A wearable like Whoop gives a rough estimate, an at-home device adds another layer of accuracy, and in-clinic diagnostics remain the gold standard for anyone who wants the most precise number. Without consistent VO2 max training, this number can decline by about 10% per year after age 30, which makes it one of the more urgent metrics to track and train against, not just observe. #VO2Max #FemaleLongevity #CardioFitness #Biomarkers #LongevitySeries #WomensHealth #FitnessOverForty

items.title: How Exercise Heals You at a Molecular Level
items.summary: Every time you work out you are creating multiple forms of stress inside your body and that is exactly the point. Exercise generates heat stress, oxidative stress, metabolic stress, and mechanical stress. Each one activates a different biological pathway. And all of them converge on the same place: your mitochondria. That is why exercise is one of the most potent activators of your body's healing systems. It is not one mechanism. It is a cascade. Dr. Sharon Bergquist breaks down the science in a way that will change how you think about every workout.
